Package ca.refundr.highspring.api.scope

Class RequestScope

java.lang.Object
ca.refundr.highspring.api.scope.RequestScope
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class RequestScope extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Everything one HTTP request needs while it is being handled.

Created by ServerScope.createRequest(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse) inside RequestFilter, closed when the filter finishes. Holds the parsed request, response writer, and (after auth) the current user.

Resource handlers should take what they need from here instead of reaching into static globals — that keeps tests able to swap database / OAuth easily.
